docs.summary: Every target this engine can build for, including any added by a plugin.
docs.remarks: Target metadata only. Which pipeline builds a target is a separate question, answered by scanning for [`BuildPipeline`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Build.BuildPipeline) subclasses, so a platform that ships a pipeline is discovered without registering anything at all.

docs.summary: The registry the editor and tooling share.
Creates a new registry and registers all built-in targets.
Adds a target, replacing any already registered under the same id.
Registers all targets from the given provider, logging a warning for any malformed target instead of failing.
Drops everything and restores the built ins, for when the editor rebuilds its registries.
docs.remarks: Targets come from scanned types like every other registry, so they have to be discarded on a reload for the same reason. Otherwise a provider deleted from user code keeps its target registered for the rest of the session.
